title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure compute services · Describe application hosting options

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe application hosting options
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure App Service?

options.text: A PaaS option for running individual containers quickly without managing virtual machines
An Azure offering for generative AI scenarios such as chat and content generation
A managed HTTP-based platform for hosting web apps, REST APIs, mobile back ends, and related workloads without managing infrastructure
Running resources only as needed and charging primarily for the execution resources consumed

questions.explanation: Azure App Service is a managed HTTP-based platform for hosting web apps, REST APIs, mobile back ends, and related workloads without managing infrastructure.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe application hosting options
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Web app refer to?

options.text: A general-purpose VM family suited to common application and web-server workloads

A GPU-enabled VM family suited to graphics and AI workloads

questions.explanation: Web app is an App Service workload for hosting browser-accessible applications.

questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of WebJob?

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe application hosting options
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Azure App Service: an App Service feature for running background programs or scripts on a schedule or trigger.
Web app: an approach that packages and isolates application components for independent deployment and scaling.
Web app: an App Service workload for hosting browser-accessible applications.
API app: a template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment.
Azure App Service: a managed HTTP-based platform for hosting web apps, REST APIs, mobile back ends, and related workloads without managing infrastructure.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure App Service — a managed HTTP-based platform for hosting web apps, REST APIs, mobile back ends, and related workloads without managing infrastructure; and Web app — an App Service workload for hosting browser-accessible applications.
